words.tr: phrase. 放手；松开；释放；放弃
words.ex: He decided to let go of the old toy.
words.ex_cn: 他决定放开那个旧玩具。
words.en: To release one's hold on something or someone; to allow someone or something to leave or be free.

words.tr: phrase. 我也是；我也是这样。
words.ex: I like pizza. Me too.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢披萨。我也是。

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；没门；不可能；表示强烈否定或惊讶
words.ex: No way will I eat that food.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会吃那种食物。
words.en: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do something or that something will happen

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始
words.ex: Come on, you can finish this race!
words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！
words.en: Used to encourage someone to do something or to hurry up, or to express disbelief or skepticism.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 不错的；挺好的；还算可以
words.ex: The food is not bad.
words.ex_cn: 这食物还不错。
words.en: Used to express that something is quite good or satisfactory, though not excellent.

words.tr: phrase. 尚未；还没有
words.ex: He has not yet finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something has not happened or been done up to the present time, especially when you expect it to happen or be done soon

words.tr: phrase. 再见（非正式告别用语）
words.ex: So long, and thanks for all the fish!
words.ex_cn: 再见，感谢所有的鱼！
words.en: Used to say goodbye.

words.tr: phrase. 为什么不（用于提出建议或表示同意）
words.ex: Why not go for a walk?
words.ex_cn: 为什么不去散个步呢？
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to agree with a suggestion

words.tr: phrase. 让我；允许我
words.ex: Allow me to help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: Permit me to do something; a polite request to act.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. 干得好；做得好（用于表扬他人）
words.ex: He did a good job on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现得很好。
words.en: An expression used to praise someone for their work or achievement.

words.tr: 玩得高兴，过得快活; 耍笑; 玩耍
words.ex: They have fun playing soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后踢足球很开心。
words.en: to enjoy oneself; to experience pleasure and enjoyment

words.tr: 我吃饱了
words.ex: I'm full after eating the big meal.
words.ex_cn: 吃完这顿大餐后，我吃饱了。

words.tr: 我迷路了；我迷失了方向；我不知所措
words.ex: I'm lost in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 我在市中心迷路了。

words.tr: phrase. 我请客；我来付钱
words.ex: It's my treat today, so I'll pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 今天我请客，所以我来付咖啡钱。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that the speaker will pay for something, typically a meal or drink, as a gesture of kindness or gratitude.

words.tr: 短语. 您先请；您先走
words.ex: After you, sir.
words.ex_cn: 先生，您先请。
words.en: A polite expression used to suggest that someone else should go first or take their turn before you.

words.tr: int. （别人打喷嚏时说的礼貌用语）保佑你
words.ex: She sneezed, and he said, 'Bless you.'
words.ex_cn: 她打了个喷嚏，他说‘保佑你’。
words.en: A polite expression said to someone after they sneeze, wishing them good health or offering comfort.

words.tr: phrase. 忘了吧；别提了；算了（用于表示放弃某事或让对方不要再提某事）
words.ex: Forget it, I will do it myself.
words.ex_cn: 算了吧，我自己做。
words.en: Used to tell someone that something is not important or not worth worrying about.

words.tr: phrase. （用于安慰）好了，别难过；得啦，别哭了
words.ex: There there, it's okay.
words.ex_cn: 好了好了，没事的。
words.en: Used to comfort someone who is upset.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 放轻松；别紧张；悠着点
words.ex: Take it easy, the test is not hard.
words.ex_cn: 别紧张，考试不难。
words.en: To relax and not do anything too energetic or stressful.

words.tr: 短语. 慢慢来；不着急；从容不迫
words.ex: You can take your time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: phr. 你可以慢慢完成这个项目。
words.en: If you tell someone to take their time, you are telling them that they do not need to hurry.

words.tr: 我很好
words.ex: I'm good, thanks for asking.
words.ex_cn: 我很好，谢谢你的关心。

words.tr: phrase. 我从未料到会这样
words.ex: I never saw it coming when the rain started suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 雨突然下起来时，我从未料到会这样。

words.tr: phrase. 祝你早日康复
words.ex: I hope you feel better soon, wish you a speedy recovery.
words.ex_cn: 我希望你早日好起来，祝你早日康复。

words.tr: phrase. 我保证；我承诺
words.ex: I promise to help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 我答应帮你做作业。
words.en: A phrase used to assure someone that you will definitely do something.

words.tr: phrase. 减速；（使）慢下来
words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr: phrase. 当心
words.ex: Take care when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious or attentive; to look after someone or something.

words.tr: 它很疼
words.ex: It hurts when I touch my arm.
words.ex_cn: 我碰胳膊时它很疼。
words.en: Causes physical or emotional pain.

words.tr: phrase. 再试一次；重新尝试
words.ex: You failed the test, but you can try again.
words.ex_cn: 你考试没通过，但你可以再试一次。
words.en: Make another attempt after a previous failure.

words.tr: phrase. 当心；提防
words.ex: Watch out for the falling tree!
words.ex_cn: 小心掉下来的树！
words.en: To be careful or cautious, especially in order to avoid danger.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）怎么了？最近怎么样？有什么事吗？
words.ex: What's up?
words.ex_cn: 怎么了？
words.en: used as a friendly greeting and to ask someone how they are or what is happening

words.tr: 短语. 小心；注意；当心
words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: To be cautious and attentive in order to avoid potential danger or mistakes.

words.tr: n. 欢呼声；激励；“cheer”的复数；
words.ex: The crowd gave cheers when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: used to express good wishes before drinking; used to express thanks or goodbye

words.tr: v. 别动
words.ex: Don't move, the dog might bite.
words.ex_cn: 别动，狗可能会咬人。
words.en: A command telling someone not to change position.

words.tr: 短语. 猜猜看，通常用于引出令人惊讶或有趣的消息
words.ex: Guess what? I got the job!
words.ex_cn: 你猜怎么着？我得到那份工作了！
words.en: Used to introduce a piece of information that is surprising or unexpected.

words.tr: phrase. 我对此表示怀疑；我不太相信
words.ex: I doubt it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我怀疑明天会下雨。
words.en: An expression of skepticism or disbelief about a statement or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 我就是这么想的。
words.ex: You said the movie starts at 8? That's what I thought.
words.ex_cn: 你说电影八点开始？我就是这么想的。

words.tr: phrase. 坚持下去；继续保持；再接再厉
words.ex: Keep it up, you are doing great!
words.ex_cn: 继续加油，你做得很好！
words.en: To continue doing something well or to maintain a good standard of performance.

words.tr: phrase. 让我想想；让我看看
words.ex: Let me see, I think I left my keys on the table.
words.ex_cn: 让我想想，我觉得我把钥匙放在桌子上了。
words.en: A request for permission to examine something or to pause for consideration.

words.tr: phrase. 没关系；不用担心
words.ex: Never mind the mistake, let's keep going.
words.ex_cn: 别管那个错误了，我们继续吧。
words.en: You say 'never mind' when you are emphasizing that something is not serious or important, especially when someone is upset about it or you are telling them not to worry about it.

words.tr: phrase. 没问题；不用谢；没关系
words.ex: No problem, I will help you.
words.ex_cn: 没问题，我会帮你。
words.en: Used to express that something is easy, acceptable, or not an issue.

words.tr: 短语. 就这些；仅此而已；没有别的了
words.ex: I have no more questions—that's all.
words.ex_cn: 我没有什么问题了，就这些。
words.en: Used to indicate that there is nothing more to say or do.

words.tr: phrase. 时间到了
words.ex: The teacher said, 'Time's up! Please hand in your papers.'
words.ex_cn: phr. 老师说：“时间到了！请交上你们的试卷。”
words.en: An expression used to indicate that the allotted time for something has ended.

words.tr: 短语. 最近有什么新鲜事；有什么新消息
words.ex: What's new?
words.ex_cn: 有什么新消息？
words.en: A casual inquiry about recent events or updates, often used as a greeting.

words.tr: 短语动词. 算我一个；让我参与
words.ex: If you're planning a trip to the mountains, count me in!
words.ex_cn: 如果你们计划去山里旅行，算我一个！
words.en: To include someone in a plan or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 别担心；不用担心
words.ex: Don't worry, the test is easy.
words.ex_cn: 别担心，考试很简单。
words.en: A phrase used to offer reassurance and comfort to someone who is worried.

words.tr: 短语动词. 感觉好些了；心情或身体状况有所改善
words.ex: She drank tea and felt better.
words.ex_cn: 她喝了茶，感觉好多了。
words.en: To experience an improvement in one's physical or emotional state.

words.tr: phrase. 这是你的吗？
words.ex: Is it yours?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的吗？

words.tr: phrase. 她和我同龄
words.ex: She's my age, so we both started school in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 她和我同龄，所以我们都是2010年上小学的。

words.tr: 短语. 给你；这就是你要的东西（用于递东西给别人时）
words.ex: Here you are, your algebra book.
words.ex_cn: 给你，你的代数书。
words.en: A phrase used to hand something to someone, meaning 'This is for you.

words.tr: 没人知道
words.ex: No one knows where he went.
words.ex_cn: 没人知道他去了哪里。
words.en: It is unknown to anyone.

words.tr: phrase. 非常高兴你能够来
words.ex: I am so glad you could come to my birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 非常高兴你能够来参加我的生日派对。

words.tr: 感叹词短语。真遗憾；多可惜啊
words.ex: What a pity! He missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 真遗憾！他没赶上公交车。
words.en: An expression used to express regret or sympathy about something.

words.tr: phrase. 还有别的东西吗；其他任何事物
words.ex: Can I get you anything else?
words.ex_cn: 你还需要其他什么东西吗？
words.en: used to ask if there is something more that someone wants or needs

words.tr: phrase. 帮我一个忙
words.ex: Can you do me a favor and pass the salt?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我个忙，把盐递过来吗？
words.en: To ask someone to help you with something, especially something that is not a big deal.

words.tr: 短语动词. 请自便；随意取用
words.ex: Help yourself to some cookies.
words.ex_cn: 随便吃些饼干。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone to take something they want or need without asking for permission.

words.tr: 我在节食
words.ex: I'm on a diet to lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 我正在节食以减肥。
words.en: A declaration that one is following a specific eating plan to control weight or health.

words.tr: phrase. 保持联系
words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.tr: 短语。谁在打电话；请问您是哪位（用于接听电话时询问对方身份）
words.ex: Who's calling please?
words.ex_cn: 请问是哪位？
words.en: A question asking for the identity of the person making a telephone call.

words.tr: 短语动词. 帮我一下；助我一臂之力
words.ex: Can you give me a hand with this box?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？
words.en: An informal request for help or assistance.

words.tr: 短语. 我不知道；我毫无头绪
words.ex: I have no idea what algebra is.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道代数是什么。
words.en: An expression used to indicate a complete lack of knowledge or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 我刚做到/我刚成功了/我勉强赶上了
words.ex: I just made it to the train before it left.
words.ex_cn: 我刚赶上火车，它就开走了。

words.tr: 我赶时间
words.ex: I'm in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我赶着去赶公交车。
words.en: A statement indicating that one is pressed for time and must leave soon.

words.tr: phrase. 由你决定；取决于你
words.ex: It's up to you to decide what to eat.
words.ex_cn: 吃什么由你决定。
words.en: The decision is yours to make.

words.tr: phrase. 我欠你一个（人情、东西等）
words.ex: I own you one for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 你帮我做作业，我欠你一个人情。

words.tr: 短语. 任何一天都可以，表示对时间没有特别要求
words.ex: Any day will do for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们旅行的任何一天都可以。
words.en: Any day is acceptable for the planned action.

words.tr: phrase. 你在开玩笑吧？
words.ex: You won the lottery? Are you kidding?
words.ex_cn: 你中了彩票？你在开玩笑吧？

words.tr: 短语. 我忍不住；我控制不住自己
words.ex: I can't help it when I laugh so hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我笑得这么厉害时，我控制不住。
words.en: Used to say that you cannot stop yourself doing something or that you cannot control your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 我不是那个意思；我不是故意的
words.ex: I said you were late, but I don't mean it.
words.ex_cn: 我说你迟到了，但我不是那个意思。

words.tr: phrase. 听起来很棒
words.ex: It sounds great to go on vacation next week.
words.ex_cn: 下周去度假听起来很棒。

words.tr: phrase. 迄今为止
words.ex: So far, he has finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; until now.

words.tr: phrase. + adj. 如此好；这么棒
words.ex: This cake is so good.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕太好吃了。
words.en: Used to express that something is very good or of high quality.

words.tr: 现在几点了（用于询问当前时间）
words.ex: What time is it?
words.ex_cn: 现在几点了？
words.en: A question asking for the current time.

words.tr: phrase. 你能做到；你能成功
words.ex: You can make it if you try hard.
words.ex_cn: 只要你努力，你就能做到。

words.tr: phrase. 控制自己，克制自己的情绪或行为
words.ex: You must control yourself when you are angry.
words.ex_cn: 当你生气时，必须控制自己。
words.en: Calm down or restrain your emotions or behavior.

words.tr: 短语动词. 卧病在床；因生病而躺在床上
words.ex: He is ill in bed with a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，躺在床上。
words.en: To be confined to bed due to illness.

words.tr: phrase. 某人缺乏勇气
words.ex: He lacks the courage to speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏在课堂上发言的勇气。

words.tr: phrase. 一切都好吗？
words.ex: Hi, how is everything with you?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你一切都好吗？

words.tr: phrase. 我别无选择；我不得不这样做
words.ex: I have no choice but to go.
words.ex_cn: 我别无选择，只能去。
words.en: There is no alternative option available.

words.tr: 我会尽我最大的努力
words.ex: I'll try my best to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我会尽我最大的努力完成我的作业。

words.tr: 我在你这边；我支持你
words.ex: I'm on your side when you face difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇到困难时，我站在你这边。
words.en: Used to express support or agreement with someone.

words.tr: 短语. 你怎么想？；你认为如何？
words.ex: I think algebra is hard.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得代数很难。
words.en: A polite inquiry asking for someone's opinion or judgment on a matter.

words.tr: 短语。谁告诉你的？
words.ex: Who told you that?
words.ex_cn: 谁告诉你的？
words.en: A question expressing surprise or disbelief at a statement made by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 中线开球；出发；开始；脱鞋
words.ex: The referee will kick off the match at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 裁判将在下午3点中线开球。
words.en: To start something, especially a game, event, or process.

words.tr: adv. 是；
words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.tr: 我猜是这样；我想是这样的
words.ex: I suppose so, but I am not sure.
words.ex_cn: 我猜是这样，但我不确定。
words.en: Used to express hesitant agreement or acceptance.

words.tr: phrase. 有什么话要对我说吗？
words.ex: Is there any message for me?
words.ex_cn: 有什么话要对我说吗？

words.tr: phrase. 别这么谦虚
短语. 别跟我来这一套；别骗我；别找借口
words.ex: Don't give me that excuse again!
words.ex_cn: 别再给我找那个借口了！
words.en: Used to express disbelief or rejection of what someone has said or done.

words.tr: phrase. 他只是个孩子
words.ex: He's just a child, so don't expect him to understand everything.
words.ex_cn: 他只是个孩子，所以别指望他理解所有事情。

words.tr: phrase. 我听不懂你说的；我跟不上你的思路
words.ex: I can't follow you when you speak too fast.
words.ex_cn: 你说话太快了，我听不懂你说的。

words.tr: phrase. v. 走得太远；做得过分
words.ex: He went too far when he broke his sister's toy.
words.ex_cn: 当他弄坏他妹妹的玩具时，他做得太过分了。
words.en: To go beyond what is reasonable or acceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 我不干了；我辞职了
words.ex: I quit my job because it was too stressful.
words.ex_cn: 我不干了，因为这份工作太有压力了。

words.tr: phrase. 无痛
words.ex: This injection causes no pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种注射无痛。

words.tr: 没有收益
words.ex: He worked hard but there was no gain.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作了，但没有收益。

words.tr: phrase. 我们完全支持它。
words.ex: We're all for it because it helps the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们完全支持它，因为它有助于环境保护。

words.tr: phrase. 真划算
words.ex: This coat costs only 20 dollars! What a good deal!
words.ex_cn: 这件外套只卖20美元！真划算！

words.tr: 你自找的；你要求的，活该如此（常用于表示某人因自己的要求或行为而招致不好的结果）
words.ex: You stayed up all night, so you asked for it.
words.ex_cn: 你熬了一整夜，你自找的。
words.en: You have brought this situation upon yourself through your own actions or words.

words.tr: phrase. 你放心，我保证（我会做到）
words.ex: You have my word that I will come early.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证我会早点来。
words.en: I promise you.

words.tr: phrase. 信不信由你
words.ex: Believe it or not, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 信不信由你，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that may seem surprising or unbelievable.

words.tr: phrase. 别让我失望；别辜负我的期望
words.ex: Don't let me down when I need you.
words.ex_cn: 当我需要你的时候，别让我失望。
words.en: An expression urging someone not to disappoint you.

words.tr: adj. 来得容易的（常用于短语 easy come, easy go，表示来得快去得也快）
words.ex: He got the money easy come, easy go.
words.ex_cn: 他钱来得容易，去得也快。

words.tr: adj. 随和的；轻松的；不拘束的
words.ex: He is an easy go person who never gets upset.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个随和的人，从不生气。

words.tr: phrase. 请再说一遍（用于没听清对方的话时）；对不起（用于道歉或请求原谅）
words.ex: I beg your pardon, I did not hear you clearly.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我没听清你的话。
words.en: A polite phrase used to ask for repetition or clarification.

words.tr: phrase. 我很快就回来
phrase. 我去查一下；我去看一看
words.ex: I'll check it out and tell you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我去查一下，明天告诉你。

words.tr: phrase. 说来话长；一言难尽
words.ex: When asked how they met, she replied, 'It's a long story.'
words.ex_cn: 当被问及他们是如何认识的时，她回答说：“说来话长。”
words.en: Used to indicate that the explanation for something is complicated or lengthy and not easily summarized.

words.tr: phrase. 等着瞧；拭目以待
words.ex: Just wait and see what happens tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 等等看明天会发生什么。
words.en: Used to tell someone to be patient and wait for a future event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 下定决心；拿定主意；作出决定
words.ex: You need to make up your mind before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 你需要在截止日期前下定决心。
words.en: To decide on something, especially after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 这就是我需要的全部
words.ex: I just need one cup of coffee, and that's all I need.
words.ex_cn: 我只需要一杯咖啡，这就是我需要的全部。

words.tr: phrase. 景色很棒
words.ex: From the top of the hill, the view is great.
words.ex_cn: 从山顶上看，景色很棒。

words.tr: 谚语. 隔墙有耳（指说话要小心，以防被他人偷听）
words.ex: Be careful what you say, walls have ears.
words.ex_cn: 小心你说的话，隔墙有耳。
words.en: Used to warn someone that there is a risk of being overheard.

words.tr: 短语. 他总是说大话；他总是吹牛
words.ex: He always talks big about winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他总是夸口说会赢得比赛。
words.en: He often exaggerates his achievements or abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 我马上就到
phrase. 知识就是力量
words.ex: Knowledge is power.
words.ex_cn: 知识就是力量。
words.en: Understanding and information give you the ability to achieve success.

words.tr: 时间快用完了；时间不多了
words.ex: Time is running out, so we must hurry.
words.ex_cn: 时间正在流逝，所以我们必须赶紧。
words.en: There is very little time left before a deadline or event occurs.

words.tr: phrase. 你有什么麻烦？
words.ex: What's your trouble? You look worried.
words.ex_cn: 你有什么麻烦？你看起来很担心。

words.tr: phrase. 你做得相当不错
words.ex: You did fairly well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 你在考试中做得相当不错。

words.tr: phrase. 人靠衣装；衣冠决定人的形象
words.ex: He wears a suit to work, because clothes make the man.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿西装，因为人靠衣装。
words.en: The idea that a person's appearance and clothing influence how others perceive their character or status.

words.tr: phrase. 失去理智；惊慌失措；慌乱
words.ex: Don't lose your head in an emergency.
words.ex_cn: 在紧急情况下不要惊慌失措。
words.en: To lose one's head means to become so upset or excited that one cannot think clearly or act sensibly.

words.tr: phrase. 开不起玩笑
words.ex: He got angry when I teased him—he really can't take a joke.
words.ex_cn: 我开玩笑逗他时他生气了——他真的开不起玩笑。

words.tr: 事情进展如何
words.ex: How are things going with your new job?
words.ex_cn: 你的新工作进展如何？

words.tr: phrase. 我对它了如指掌。
words.ex: I know all about it because I worked on it for years.
words.ex_cn: 我对它了如指掌，因为我为此工作了多年。

words.tr: phrase. 这确实需要时间。
words.ex: It really takes time to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 这确实需要时间来学习一门新语言。

words.tr: phrase. 爱我
words.ex: She says, 'Love me,' every night before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上睡觉前说：'爱我。'
words.en: A colloquial imperative or affectionate request, often used in informal speech or song lyrics to express a desire for affection.

words.tr: 短语 爱我的狗
words.ex: I love my dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都爱我的狗。

words.tr: phrase. 我在流口水；馋得直流口水
words.ex: The smell of fresh cookies makes my mouth water.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜饼干的香味让我流口水。
words.en: An expression indicating that someone is eagerly anticipating eating something delicious.

words.tr: phrase. 你发生了什么事？
words.ex: What happened to you? Your arm is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 你发生了什么事？你的胳膊受伤了。

words.tr: phrase. 你来得正是时候
words.ex: You are just in time for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你来得正是时候吃晚饭。

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 别这么孩子气

words.w: Here is a gift for you
words.tr: phrase. 这是给你的礼物
words.ex: Here is a gift for you.
words.ex_cn: 这是给你的礼物。

words.tr: phrase. 随时欢迎回来
words.ex: Thank you for visiting! Please come back anytime.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你的光临！随时欢迎回来。

words.w: You've got to put yourself together
words.tr: phrase. 你必须振作起来；你得整理好自己
words.ex: You've got to put yourself together after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后你必须振作起来。

words.tr: phrase. 我会一直在你身边支持你
phrase. 我赶上了最后一班公交车
words.ex: I caught the last bus and arrived home before it rained.
words.ex_cn: 我赶上了最后一班公交车，在下雨前到家了。

words.tr: phrase. 我几乎说不出话来
words.ex: I can hardly speak after running so far.
words.ex_cn: 我跑了这么远，几乎说不出话来。

words.tr: phrase. 你不会错过的；非常明显，容易找到
words.ex: You can't miss it, it's right next to the post office.
words.ex_cn: 你不可能错过它，它就在邮局旁边。
words.en: it is very easy to find or notice

words.tr: phrase. 答案是零
words.ex: When you subtract 5 from 5, the answer is zero.
words.ex_cn: 当你用5减去5时，答案是零。

words.tr: phrase. 尽快，尽早（表示某事应以最快速度完成）
words.ex: Please send the report as soon as possible.
words.ex_cn: 请尽快发送报告。
words.en: If you say that something will happen as soon as possible, you mean that it will happen as quickly as it can.

words.tr: phrase. 我为你感到非常骄傲
words.ex: I'm very proud of you for passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我为你通过考试感到非常骄傲。

words.tr: phrase. 这讲不通；这没道理；这毫无意义
words.ex: It doesn't make sense to buy a car without a license.
words.ex_cn: 没有驾照就买车没有意义。
words.en: phrase. If you say that something does not make sense, you mean that it is not reasonable or sensible, or that you cannot understand it.

words.tr: phrase. 与你无关；少管闲事
words.ex: When I asked him about his salary, he just said, 'None of your business.'
words.ex_cn: 当我问起他的薪水时，他只是说，'不关你的事。'
words.en: used to tell someone that you do not want them to know about something because it is private or does not concern them

words.tr: phrase. 静悄悄的，一点声音都没有
words.ex: Not a sound was heard in the classroom during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 考试期间教室里静悄悄的，一点声音都没有。

words.tr: phrase. 总是这样；情况一向如此
words.ex: When it rains, the roads get slippery; that's always the case.
words.ex_cn: 一下雨，路就滑，总是这样。

words.tr: 短语. 你怎么了？（用于询问对方身体不适或情绪异常的原因）
words.ex: What's wrong with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: An inquiry about the reason for someone's unusual or problematic behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 美好的一天
words.ex: It is a lovely day to go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 这是个出去散步的美好一天。

words.tr: phrase. 不是吗？（用于寻求确认或表示同意）
words.ex: Isn't it cold today?
words.ex_cn: 今天不是很冷吗？
words.en: A tag question used to seek confirmation or agreement.

words.tr: phrase. 就在附近；即将来临；近在咫尺
words.ex: The grocery store is just around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 杂货店就在拐角处。
words.en: If you say that something is just around the corner, you mean that it will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 仅仅为了娱乐
words.ex: He watches funny videos just for entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 他看搞笑视频仅仅为了娱乐。

words.tr: 短语 我怎么会知道；我哪知道
words.ex: How should I know where he went?
words.ex_cn: 我怎么会知道他去哪了？
words.en: A rhetorical question expressing that the speaker does not know the answer.

words.tr: phrase. 猪会飞（喻指绝不可能发生的事）
words.ex: He said he would clean his room without being told — pigs can fly!
words.ex_cn: 他说他会在没人提醒的情况下打扫房间——猪都会飞了！

words.tr: phrase. 我就在一声呼唤之遥
words.ex: If you need help, I'm just a shout away.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，我就在一声呼唤之遥。

words.tr: phrase. 只需点击一下即可获得
words.ex: You can get the book; it's just a click away.
words.ex_cn: 你可以得到这本书；只需点击一下即可获得。

words.tr: phrase. 我会把它记在心里；我会记住的
words.ex: I'll bear it in mind.
words.ex_cn: 我会记住的。
words.en: I will remember or consider this information for future reference.

words.tr: phrase. 我也一样；我这里也相同（用于回应别人所说的情况也适用于自己）
words.ex: I love this song. Same here!
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这首歌。我也是！
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is in the same situation or has the same opinion as someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 一点也不在乎；完全不关心
words.ex: I couldn't care any less about the game's result.
words.ex_cn: 我对比赛的结果一点也不在乎。

words.tr: 我曾经去过那里；我有过类似经历（常用于表示理解对方处境）
words.ex: I've been there.
words.ex_cn: 我去过那里。
words.en: I have experienced a similar situation.

words.w: There are butterflies in my chest
words.tr: phrase. 心里七上八下；紧张得心跳加速
words.ex: There are butterflies in my chest before my job interview.
words.ex_cn: 我在面试前心里七上八下。

words.tr: phrase. 我会再联系你；稍后回复你
words.ex: I'll get back to you as soon as I have more information.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 我一有更多信息就会回复你。
words.en: A phrase used to tell someone that you will give them a reply at a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 我跟你说啊；我告诉你个主意
words.ex: I tell you what, let's go eat pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我跟你说啊，我们今晚去吃披萨吧。

words.tr: phrase. 别闹了；住手；别再这样了（常用于要求某人停止某种令人不悦的行为）
words.ex: Cut it out! I'm trying to concentrate.
words.ex_cn: 别闹了！我正努力集中注意力。
words.en: An informal expression used to tell someone to stop doing something that is annoying or unwanted.

words.tr: phrase. 住手；别闹了；别再这样（表示制止或让对方停止做某事）
words.ex: He was making too much noise, so I told him to knock it off.
words.ex_cn: 他太吵了，所以我让他停下来。
words.en: To stop doing something, especially something that is annoying or causing trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 我深有同感；我完全理解（用于表示对他人所说情况的强烈认同，常带无奈或共鸣语气）
words.ex: He told me about it yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天告诉我关于它的事。
words.en: used to say that you already know and completely agree with what someone has said, because you have experienced it yourself

words.tr: phrase. 老一套的；一成不变的
words.ex: Every year, it's the same old routine at the office party.
words.ex_cn: 每年，办公室聚会都是老一套。
words.en: Used to refer to something that is boring because it has been seen or done many times before.
